remarks: Welcome to this charming and completely updated Tudor colonial with old turn-of-the-century character. Located in the desirable Glenbrook neighborhood of Stamford, it's a pearl of great value you'll fall in love with. Walk into an inviting hallway and experience a beautiful open floor concept. A sun-filled living room with a brick fireplace, connecting into a dining room and entirely new kitchen, new cabinets, new island, quartz countertops and new stainless steel appliances that will inspire many family gatherings and entertaining occasions. Hardwood floors provide timeless character to the main level. The kitchen connects to a spacious mudroom with a huge pantry and a full-tub bathroom with a view to your own private fenced-in backyard, including a renovated two-car garage. Retire upstairs and encounter a completely new and modern full-size bathroom. Walk through the hardwood floor hallway to three luminous and sizeable bedrooms, each with its own closet. Access is available to a foamed insulated attic, providing energy costs savings through all seasons. Additional features include: two-zoned HVAC, new electric system, new plumbing system, new replacement windows. Interior and exterior of house completely repainted. A semi-finished walk-out basement . Could easily be finished for a facility room, gym or home office. Private driveway and updated one-car front garage.
